import json
from messages import sanitize

# Test 1: Check if 'id', 'output', 'model', and 'meta' are removed
sample_messages = [
    {"id": 1, "content": "Hello", "output": "World", "model": "gpt-3", "meta": {"key": "value"}},
    {"content": "Hi", "other_field": "data"}
]

sanitized = sanitize(sample_messages)

# Check removed fields
assert len(sanitized) == len(sample_messages)
assert all("id" not in msg for msg in sanitized)
assert all("output" not in msg for msg in sanitized)
assert all("model" not in msg for msg in sanitized)
assert all("meta" not in msg for msg in sanitized)

# Test 2: Check if other fields are preserved
assert all("content" in msg for msg in sanitized)
assert all("other_field" in sanitized[1] for _ in sanitized)

# Test 3: Check if original content is preserved (excluding removed fields)
assert sanitized[0]["content"] == "Hello"
assert sanitized[1]["other_field"] == "data"

# Test 4: Check if original structure is preserved (e.g., no new fields added)
assert all(len(msg) == 1 for msg in sanitized[:1])  # Only 'content' remains in first message
assert len(sanitized[1]) == 2  # 'content' and 'other_field' remain in second message

print("All tests passed!")
